text: Dynamics [Gr. dunamikoV , pertaining to forces]: Ger. Dynamik ; Fr. dynamique ; Ital. dinamica . The science which treats of the laws of motion of bodies, as produced by the action of forces. Now proposed to be extended so as to include both branches of theoretical MECHANICS (q.v.). ( S.N. )
